title: Board of Executive Clemency established
summary: The board recommends commutations, pardons and reprieves to the governor and decides release and revocation matters.

title: Audit: former chair resigned after conflict-of-interest probe
summary: A state performance audit reported that a former chair and executive director resigned after a 2013 investigation substantiated conflict-of-interest concerns, and it flagged untimely victim notices.

title: Legislative sunset review recommends continuing the board
summary: A Senate committee of reference report on the board's sunset review recommended continuing it.
note: Date taken from the report's legislative session (56th Leg., 2nd Regular).

title: Audit: revocation hearings late, no structured decision-making
summary: The Auditor General found about one-third of revocation hearings missed the 60-day target and that the board had not adopted a structured decision-making process.
